items.title: SD-106 encoder-plane PC-recoverability probe (which directions the code keeps) + MECH-566 ZCA reconditioning falsifier on one shared SD-106@epochs40 P0a warm
items.note: SD-106 ENCODER-PLANE PROBE (chip-20260919-sd106-subspace-overlap-moderator-probe, user option C 2026-09-19T00:49Z) + MECH-566 RECONDITIONING FALSIFIER (proposal EXP-0250; the 2026-09-19 v3 completion decision memo's 'immediate next diagnostic'), ONE run on a SHARED SD-106 P0a warm at epochs=40 (user decision 2026-09-19 'one run, shared warm-up'); two INDEPENDENT pre-registered criteria on two claims (P1 -> SD-106, M1 -> MECH-566), per-claim directions and per-claim non-degeneracy. | HALF A (SD-106): P1 = ABSOLUTE PC-recoverability of the SD-106 code on the in-situ-captured P0a buffer and the trainer's own split (x1041 apparatus): unweighted mean over the 32 train-split PC directions of the 0-clipped holdout R^2 of each PC score from the code; ceiling 1.0 EXACT (PCA-32 coordinates). HIGH >= 0.90 -> retained_directions_are_pca32 (re-opens the 1023a which-directions elimination; Half B becomes load-bearing); LOW <= 0.75 -> which_directions_confirmed_directly; premise parity_ratio >= 0.95 (1041 measured 0.980); non-degeneracy = the in-run UNTRAINED encoder reads <= 0.75 on a seed majority. Principal angles (the chip's original statistic) are RECORDED for every code but route nothing: the cross-model red-team showed a random-init encoder already reads 0.95 of its ceiling. Also recorded: OFF code (shipped epochs=12, budget-UNMATCHED negative control), random orthonormal projection, decision-cell R^2 (code vs PCA-32 vs untrained), PC tail mean, sense-vs-path feature gap (SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY). | HALF B (MECH-566): frozen sense-time z_world on the x1002 BC dataset presented to x734.PPOPolicyNet@128 (x1010 fit protocol) under diag (the lineage baseline, replicated in-run) / ZCA (RELATIVE ridge 1e-3 lambda_max) / LDA (label-supervised, recorded only). M1 = ZCA lift over diag at mlp128: >= 0.05 on a seed majority CONFIRM (supports); in (-0.05, 0.02) FALSIFY (weakens); <= -0.05 HARMFUL (indeterminate; consumer_input_spectrum + column RMS say whether amplification); else PARTIAL (mixed -- the claim's registered grey zone, pre-registered as an acceptable terminal reading). Per-component standardisation is ALREADY the lineage baseline (x1002.STANDARDISE_FEATURES), so the diagonal member of MECH-566's family is exonerated by V3-EXQ-1023a's own 0.7273 and this run tests the full-covariance members only. Converged L-BFGS linear probe (GL-invariant content check, SD-106 vs PCA-32) recorded, not routed. | WHY P0a-ONLY (~1-2 h, not 1023a's 18.7 h): allon_training records P0b/P1 cover no latent_stack parameter (x1041 ran P0a-only on that basis). CHECKED, not assumed: readiness precondition sd106_consumer_diag_reproduces_1023a requires |in-run diag@mlp128 - 1023a (0.7542/0.7356/0.6921)| <= 0.05 per seed; unmet -> substrate_not_ready_requeue and the successor letter pays the full warm. Other preconditions: rawfield >= 0.6, PCA-32 anchor >= 0.85 majority (both certified reachable against x1023's V3-EXQ-1010 references), bypass trained, encoder trained, PR >= 2, buffer captured exactly, transforms invertible (1e-4), P0a steps >= 1000. Each HALF is voided only by ITS OWN instrument's preconditions (gate_a / gate_b). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readouts = (a) PC recoverability of the SD-106@40 code on the P0a buffer, (b) consumer agreement under ZCA on the SD-106 code. Checked V3-EXQ-1023a (agreement under diag only; no P0a buffer capture), V3-EXQ-1041 (buffer + OLS R^2, no recoverability, no consumer), V3-EXQ-1008 (ZCA on the OFF code: +0.040/+0.030/+0.048, grey zone -- prior, not this code). Not recoverable -> run; DOWNGRADED to the untested members. | Step 2.5: SD-106 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md:427); MECH-566 candidate/v3_pending (testable, not promotable). 2.5a: probe confirms x1023._make_sd106_agent + x1023a.P0A_CONFIG resolve to epochs=40/pw=200 with the bypass reachable (dry manifest skip_weight_norm 1.0, n_world_encoder_changed 4). 2.5b re-derive brake: SD-106 0 hits, MECH-566 0 hits. 2.5c: degrading overlaps SD-106/SD-018 (zworld_p0.py, stack.py -- the subject), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (sense/_z_world_path -- both sources run and the gap is recorded); allon_training entries NOT exercised (no _train_all_on_agent call); corrupting entries (MECH-320, sd105, sd_blocked_agency, contextmemory-write) config-disabled on the x724 all-ON stack or on paths this driver never runs (no select_action/step; sense() only for the frozen replay). GOV-FROZEN-1/GFLAG-0312: claim-level criteria only, NO new leg on zworld_actor_adequacy_locus. | DV-SYMMETRY: the DV is held-out oracle-action agreement (argmax over a freshly-fitted decoder's logits). Half B's manipulation changes the decoder's INPUT coordinates, not a broadcast constant / monotone logit rescaling / permutation; at the LINEAR rung a converged fit IS invariant by design, so the linear rung is an instrument check, not a criterion. Half A carries no manipulation. PCA-32 anchor and raw-field arms are unmanipulated references. | red-team (opus, pass 1): BLOCKING -> 7 findings, 6 FIXED (F1 by user decision: P1 statistic replaced), 1 DISMISSED (F6: the bands are MECH-566's registered ones). red-team (opus, pass 2, the one permitted re-spawn): BLOCKING -> 6 findings, 5 FIXED (RT2-1 absolute recoverability; RT2-2 clipped R^2; RT2-3 consumer_input_spectrum; RT2-4 per-half gates; RT2-6 M1 on ZCA only), RT2-5 PARTLY FIXED (HARMFUL symmetric at -0.05) / partly DISMISSED (paired same-init design is the lineage's null). No third pass. Full record in the driver docstring. | smoke PASS (--dry-run exit 0, 17 verdict lines, self-test OK, validate_experiments --strict 0 warnings, validate_recording OK). estimated_minutes 120 is a guess for a P0a-only lineage (1041's 24 P0a warms took 97 s; the cost is the sense() replay and 45 consumer fits).
